item.title: Pull request #3037 created
item.description:
2567 Allow one named record type to extend another

Another attempt to get (labeled) records extensible:

  • It is close to what has originally been proposed in #2567.
  • I am optimistic that a processor can often find out whether a record shall be internally treated as extensible, which is why I haven’t added any %extensible or %final annotations.
  • However, I believe we will make our life much easier by going without restricts.

Closes #2567
